Native-safety: a `WebLikeStorage` interface (getItem/setItem/removeItem) plus a `webStorage()` accessor reading `globalThis.localStorage` replace the source's direct global `localStorage` references. Under the react-native-web build this resolves to the real window.localStorage (full web parity — identical key, envelope shape, CAP, MIN_QUERY_LEN, DEFAULT_RETURN). Under Hermes/native it is undefined, so load() returns an empty envelope and save()/_resetSearchHistory() no-op — recent-search history degrades to effectively-disabled in-memory behavior without throwing, exactly matching the web resilience contract where any storage failure yields an empty store. The module has zero external imports; no DOM, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, react-leaflet, lucide-react, or old web UI components are introduced.
